verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Kling serves a live llms.txt at kling.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its content is agent-oriented: product capabilities, RESTful API authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey JWT), global and China API endpoints, per-unit pricing, and plan details, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or full machine-readable API reference (the developer docs are an SPA shell and kling.ai/openapi.json serves only the application shell), the llms.txt leans toward marketing and pricing rather than endpoint-level detail, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: RESTful API with JWT-based authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey)
